profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer | Embedded Systems | Embedded Software

positions.title: Distinguished Member of the Technical Staff
positions.description:
Sensors and Contextual Awareness Team

- Individual contributor and lead for sensing topics. Completed supplier-interfacing, technical assessment, cost / benefit trade-offs, and downstream coordination of sensing technologies, as well as investigations of forward-looking technologies.

- Led collaboration with Chicago-based product teams and China-based sensor team, ensuring consistent and cost-effective sensor solutions.

- Worked with inventors, improving filing success rate as Patent Committee Technical Reviewer for novelty and feasibility.

positions.title: Distinguished Member of the Technical Staff
positions.description:
Advanced Concepts Lab

- Led software and EE teams in creating proof of concept devices.

- Prototyped wearable and “thin” devices and 3D displays, leading to products including RAZR, Moto ACTV and Moto 360.

positions.title: Distinguished Member Of Technical Staff / Speech Lab Manager
positions.description:
PCS Research Speech Lab

- Managed small team developing speech recognition, noise-reduction algorithms, and multimodal user interfaces.

- Progressed speech recognition technology from Speaker Dependent to Speaker Independent recognition, providing expanded and more natural user interaction. 

- Prototyped and demonstrated a Distributed Speech Recognition and multimodal user interface system.
